summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) on May 20, 2026, to announce that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per common share. The dividend is payable on July 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital-return event, not a special-situation category. There are no deal terms, acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review involved. The filing is a standard current report of an ordinary dividend declaration.
